name: Glances — Status
description: Live system stats from a Glances instance: CPU / RAM / disk / load / uptime, with a tone-coded state pill that swings from ok → warn → danger as the headline metric crosses thresholds.

cell_options.name: label
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Shown in the title bar. Leave blank to fall back to the Glances hostname.

settings.name: base_url
settings.label: Glances URL
settings.help: Base URL of a Glances REST server (the host that runs `glances -w`). Tesserae appends /api/4/all itself.

settings.name: username
settings.label: Username (optional)
settings.help: Set only if your Glances instance is started with --username; otherwise leave blank.

settings.name: password
settings.label: Password (optional)
settings.help: Pairs with the username above for HTTP Basic auth.
